verdict.rationale: No evidence Sprinto offers any data export in open formats (CSV/JSON/API dump) or a documented offboarding/export process; docs focus on ingestion, integrations and monitoring, not portability out of the platform. Community reports even describe friction when trying to leave (account disabled, termination disputes), but this doesn't confirm or deny an open-format export capability, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
